title: Banjo Bernie's name and Callender's banjo ukulele
summary: Callender says Bernie was the leader's last name and recalls his own brief attempt at the banjo uke.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Banjo Bernie, do you remember what his whole name was, or was that all the name you ever heard?

I don't remember his name. I know he had a first name, but everybody called him Banjo Bernie, because that's what he played -- banjo and guitar. But the banjo seems to have stuck, because banjo was a popular instrument during that time. I remember when I was a youngster I used to get the magazines with Charles Atlas and all of the savs(?) you could send for and sell, and you could earn a ukelele. So my choice was a banjo uke. And I learned two or three chords on it, but that really wasn't my thing.
Bernie was his last name, yeah.
And nobody ever used any other first names than "Banjo."
He did have a first name, but at this point I really can't remember it. All I remember is the Banjo Bernie.
